text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black takes on the St. Lite Kinen 
at a mid-distance of 2,200m.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Due to her association with sprint 
specialist Sakura Bakushin O, some doubted 
her distance aptitude. But the Trainer 
sent her off with reassurance that there 
was nothing to worry about.
